data.explanation: Your US student health insurer needs more paperwork to process your emergency room claim: an itemized bill and proof that you paid it. The letter states the documents must arrive by September 30, 2026 — that is today, so send them (e.g. by email to claims@eshp.example) as soon as possible. If the insurer does not receive them in time, it will close the claim, and you would likely need to re-open or re-file it later. Keep a copy of everything you send, and note the reference numbers when you contact them.
